label: preserve
contract: get returns its default argument (None unless given) for a key that was never stored.
visible_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(3, 60)
assert cache.get("x", 5) is None
assert cache.get("x", 5, default=0) == 0, cache.get("x", 5, default=0)
heldout_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(2, 10)
cache.put("known", 1, 0)
assert cache.get("nope", 0) is None
assert cache.get("nope", 0, "fallback") == "fallback"

label: arbitrary
contract: An entry stored at time t is returned while now < t + ttl and has expired once now >= t + ttl.
visible_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(4, 5)
cache.put("a", "A", 20)
cache.put("b", "B", 20)
assert cache.get("a", 24) == "A", cache.get("a", 24)
assert cache.get("b", 25) is None, cache.get("b", 25)
heldout_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(4, 10)
cache.put("k1", "v1", 100)
cache.put("k2", "v2", 100)
assert cache.get("k1", 109) == "v1"
assert cache.get("k2", 110) is None

label: arbitrary
contract: When a new key is put into a full cache, the entry whose most recent put is oldest is evicted, however recently it was read.
visible_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(2, 100)
cache.put("x", "X", 0)
cache.put("y", "Y", 1)
assert cache.get("x", 2) == "X"
cache.put("z", "Z", 3)
assert cache.get("x", 4) is None, "x should have been evicted"
assert cache.get("y", 4) == "Y" and cache.get("z", 4) == "Z"
cache = ExpiringCache(3, 100)
cache.put("p", "P", 0)
cache.put("q", "Q", 1)
cache.put("p", "P2", 2)
cache.put("r", "R", 3)
cache.put("s", "S", 4)
assert cache.get("q", 5) is None, "q should have been evicted"
assert cache.get("p", 5) == "P2" and cache.get("r", 5) == "R" and cache.get("s", 5) == "S"
heldout_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(3, 100)
cache.put("a", "A", 0)
cache.put("b", "B", 1)
cache.put("c", "C", 2)
assert cache.get("a", 3) == "A"
cache.put("d", "D", 4)
assert cache.get("a", 5) is None
assert cache.get("b", 5) == "B" and cache.get("c", 5) == "C" and cache.get("d", 5) == "D"
cache = ExpiringCache(3, 100)
cache.put("a", "A", 0)
cache.put("b", "B", 1)
cache.put("a", "A2", 2)
cache.put("c", "C", 3)
cache.put("d", "D", 4)
assert cache.get("b", 5) is None
assert cache.get("a", 5) == "A2" and cache.get("c", 5) == "C" and cache.get("d", 5) == "D"

label: inferable
contract: Putting a key that is already stored replaces its value and never evicts another entry.
visible_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(3, 50)
cache.put("k1", 1, 0)
cache.put("k2", 2, 0)
cache.put("k3", 3, 0)
cache.put("k2", 20, 1)
assert cache.get("k1", 2) == 1, "k1 should still be cached"
assert cache.get("k2", 2) == 20 and cache.get("k3", 2) == 3
heldout_check:
from expiring_cache import ExpiringCache
cache = ExpiringCache(2, 10)
cache.put("a", "A", 0)
cache.put("b", "B", 1)
cache.put("b", "B2", 2)
assert cache.get("a", 3) == "A"
assert cache.get("b", 3) == "B2"
